description: This file contains UI components and Composable functions for displaying and managing a task list in an Android app. It includes screens for listing tasks, dialogs for adding/editing tasks, and UI elements like task items, headers, and empty state indicators.

methods.name: TaskListScreen
methods.description: Main screen composable displaying the list of tasks, with header, floating action button, and dialogs.

methods.name: EmptyState
methods.description: Displays a message indicating no tasks are present.

methods.name: formattedTime
methods.description: Formats a timestamp (milliseconds) into a readable string.

methods.name: TaskItemView
methods.description: Displays individual task details with options to edit, delete, and toggle completion.

methods.name: AddEditTaskDialog
methods.description: Dialog for adding or editing a task, with validation.
